speaker: R
text: An invisible elephant made my principal four hundred dollars in one lunch break.

speaker: R
text: My little brother started it by selling invisible pets at school.

speaker: R
text: Five dollars got you a leash, an empty box, and a certificate.

speaker: R
text: Then Coach Miller climbed onto an invisible horse and rode straight into a real tree.

speaker: R
text: Soon kids were blocking the hallway to walk their invisible dogs.

speaker: R
text: She only asked how much my brother had made.

speaker: R
text: Then she asked which pets were left.

speaker: R
text: Next morning, I saw a giant bag of peanuts outside her office.

speaker: R
text: My brother went in holding an empty leash.

speaker: R
text: He came out holding fifty dollars.

speaker: R
text: At lunch, she opened the gym doors.

speaker: R
text: Forty kids were waiting beside a tiny step stool.

speaker: R
text: She was selling elephant rides for ten dollars each.

speaker: R
text: My brother bought the first ticket.

speaker: R
text: He paid with the money she'd just given him.

speaker: R
text: That was the first ten dollars she made.
